question_text: At 2:35 pm Fari sees an airplane directly overhead. At 2:38 pm he estimates that the angle of elevation to the plane is $15^\circ$. The plane is travelling in a straight line at $110\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Calculate:

subparts.stem: the height of the plane above the ground

mark_breakdown.desc: Calculate range and quartiles for Cailan
Calculate range and quartiles for Miles

subparts.solution:
Cailan:
$$\text{range} = \text{maximum} - \text{minimum} = 92 - 79 = 13$$
We have an even number of data values, so we include all data values when we split the data set into two:
Lower half: $79, 80, 81, 83, 84$; Upper half: $85, 86, 87, 90, 92$
$$Q_1 = \text{median of lower half} = 81$$
$$Q_3 = \text{median of upper half} = 87$$
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 87 - 81 = 6$$

Miles:
$$\text{range} = \text{maximum} - \text{minimum} = 91 - 82 = 9$$
We have an even number of data values, so we include all data values when we split the data set into two:
Lower half: $82, 82, 83, 84, 84$; Upper half: $85, 87, 88, 90, 91$
$$Q_1 = \text{median of lower half} = 83$$
$$Q_3 = \text{median of upper half} = 88$$
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 88 - 83 = 5$$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: To find spread, calculate range as $\max - \min$ and IQR as $Q_3 - Q_1$ by splitting the 10 data values into two halves of 5 values each.
step_by_step: For Cailan: range is $92 - 79 = 13$. The middle of the first 5 values is 81 ($Q_1$), and middle of upper 5 values is 87 ($Q_3$). IQR is $87 - 81 = 6$.
For Miles: range is $91 - 82 = 9$. The middle of the first 5 values is 83 ($Q_1$), and middle of upper 5 values is 88 ($Q_3$). IQR is $88 - 83 = 5$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Misidentifying the median of the 5-element halves.

subparts.stem: the angle of elevation to the plane at 2:42 pm.

mark_breakdown.desc: Set up tangent ratio with height and new horizontal distance

subparts.solution: $y = \text{speed} \times \text{time} = 110 \times 420 = 46\,200\text{ m}$ {7 minutes = 420 seconds}. $\tan\theta \approx \frac{5305.39}{46\,200} \implies \theta \approx \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{5305.39}{46\,200}\right) \approx 6.55^\circ$. Therefore, the angle of elevation of the plane at 2:42 pm is approximately $6.55^\circ$.

ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Using the rounded height $5310$ instead of unrounded value, or miscalculating elapsed time.
